title: Emerging Cases of Fascioliasis in Lorestan Province, Western Iran: Case Series Report
case_text: A 25-yr-old woman from Darbid Village in Delfan County in Lorestan Province, Iran. She was pregnant and had a history of abdominal and back pain, sore throat and consumptions of aquatic plants especially "Balmak" in a recent month. She had no significant weight loss and cutaneous manifestation. All diagnostic measures were conducted similar to previous case. The patient's related sequence with accession number MF187502 was recorded at the GenBank. After treatment, following up of the patient was performed after 1, 3 and 6-months and stool exam was negative.

4. TARGET CANONICAL DISEASE:
   - The verified ground-truth disease for this patient is: Foodborne Trematodes
   - Disease subtype / specific manifestation: fascioliasis in a pregnant patient
